questions.question: Whom does Psalm 134 address?
options: The mighty angels of heaven who continually surround the throne
The kings of all the earth who gather themselves together for war
The elders of the great city who sit in judgment at the gate
The servants of the LORD who stand by night in the house of the LORD
questions.answer: The servants of the LORD who stand by night in the house of the LORD

questions.question: What are they told to do?
options: Bring their offerings to the altar and pay their vows
Bow their faces to the ground and confess their sins
Raise their voices in the streets and proclaim his deeds
Lift up their hands to the holy place and bless the LORD
questions.answer: Lift up their hands to the holy place and bless the LORD

questions.question: The psalm ends with a blessing: May the LORD bless you from Zion, he who made heaven and earth.
Come, _____ the LORD, all you servants of the LORD!
May the LORD bless you from _____, he who made heaven and earth!
